product_from_film: Libra AI connects work apps to prepare meetings, create material, take notes and perform follow-up tasks from requests.
explains_well: One hiring meeting connects context gathering, a deck, meeting notes, messages and an applicant-tracking workflow.
unclear: Most results remain small floating panels, so the viewer cannot inspect the exact deck, message content or hiring-system change before the film says everything is done.
scenario: Prepare for a hiring meeting and complete its follow-up across work apps.
product_clear_basis: The request for prior emails, last-call context and a deck is paired with task panels and a slide preview.

lessons.keep: Connect several app actions through one meeting with a clear before-and-after sequence.
try: Show the meeting notes beside the generated summary email, including a visible review and send step.
Show the ATS record before and after the interview workflow, with only the changed fields highlighted.
lessons.avoid: Avoid making completion badges carry all the proof of a finished workflow.
lessons.open: What exact records changed, and where can the user review them before actions are taken?
